note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it. Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, and cite their sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to do for it. Treat it as the finish line: work through the roadmap stages in order, and when the last trophy on your checklist ticks over, this one follows at once. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours in a single playthrough, and Push Square puts it at 300 hours or more.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. Just play the story from the start and it pops when the mission ends. This is the first trophy most players earn, and it opens the checklist.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 1. It pops at the chapter's end, so keep playing the main missions in order. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — it is tied to the one trophy that can be missed (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 2. It pops at the chapter's end. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — play the main missions in order and it comes to you.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 3. It pops at the chapter's end. While you are in this chapter, finish the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun, which later helps with the Sneakthief trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 4. It pops at the chapter's end. One of this chapter's optional missions opens the bank vaults, which the Maximum Withdrawal trophy needs, so take the optional missions when they appear.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the final mission and watch the credits roll. After it pops you can keep exploring Leonida freely, and the 100% Completion checklist opens (Touch Pad, then Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), so the real clean-up work starts here, not before.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Play the main missions in order and it pops on completion — no side work needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-story heist, so follow the mission markers in order and it pops when the job is done.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends — just play the story through and it comes to you.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Headliners. A main-story mission, so it pops on completion with no preparation and no way to miss it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Play the story in order and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops at the end of the mission — a straight story beat with nothing to prepare.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players earn. Open the checklist after the story at Touch Pad, Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Despite the name, you do not have to do literally everything: 15 of the 18 collectible card sets count, 70 of the 80 Challenges, and 300 of the 397 stunts. Most of the list is finished by doing the other trophies, so save this for the final clean-up and work down the checklist line by line. PowerPyx calls it roughly 60% of true completion.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida — a little over half. The four kinds are stunt jumps (130), flying under bridges (202), knife flights between tall buildings (40) and base jumps (25), and you can mix them freely, so pick the kinds you enjoy and skip the rest. Find them on the map at Touch Pad, Exploration, Stunt Spots, and track progress at Progress, Activities, Stunts. Note that 300 stunts are needed for 100% completion, so you will come back to this.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. You do not need to win or finish any of them — one attempt at each is enough. The fastest way is to open the Activities list (Touch Pad, Activities) and work down it: a shooting range, a drone race, a race, fishing, an arcade game, bowling, a stunt, a meditation and a card hunt cover the set between them. It pops as soon as the ninth type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — find them at Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to gold, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows. Work through one range completely before moving to the other, and track progress at Activities, Shooting Ranges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — one win at each, not every race. Some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Find them at Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones. Learn each course's corners on a practice run first, then race to win; for 100% completion you will eventually need all 42 races, but this trophy only needs the 14 wins.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — winning the same race twice does not count. Race locations appear across Leonida as you explore; track them at Touch Pad, Activities, Racing. Most locations let you hire a car if yours is weak, and a car's Rating matters: improve it with upgrades from Mod Shops before a hard race. Start with the short street races, then work up to the longer ones.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Fairly early in the game Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. Take a boat with a fishing rod to the area marked on your map — you can hijack one nearby if you do not own one — and fish there until you land a fish of the right size, then bring it to Cal to win the challenge. If the fish you catch are too small, keep fishing in the same spot; size varies from catch to catch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at any arcade machine in Leonida, not just start one. Pick the shortest game on offer, learn its controls in the first minute, and play it through to the end screen. Any arcade cabinet counts, so use whichever is nearest when you are passing.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Andy's missions, up to and including his last one. Andy's strand is a side-character chain, not a main-story mission, so watch for his marker on the map and take his jobs whenever they appear. The trophy pops when his final mission ends.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission chain, ending with the mission Maritime Disputes. Take Kenton's jobs as they appear on the map and the trophy pops when that last mission ends. Kenton's strand is one of the five side-character chains in the game.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission chain, ending with the mission Hometown Heroes. Billy's jobs appear as side missions on the map; take them when they show up and the trophy pops when his final mission ends.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. PowerPyx counts 14 strands in the game, but not all of them count toward this trophy: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do count, while the chains for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not — those have their own trophies. So do not waste time finishing every stranger; pick eight of the qualifying ones and finish each strand to its end. Stranger markers appear on the map as you explore.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Randy's missions, up to and including his last one. Randy's chain is built around his vehicle wish list — he asks for specific vehicles, so keep an eye out for them while driving around Leonida and deliver each one he names. The trophy pops when his final mission ends.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Tyrone's missions, up to and including his last one. His chain involves the Kitty Litter Labs, and a list of their locations helps you move through his jobs without wandering. Take his missions as they appear and the trophy pops at the end of his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the only trophy in the game flagged as possibly missable. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations, as Jason and Lucia. Do the first one as soon as you can: Lucia's meditation on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, which is reported to disappear once that chapter ends — it is not confirmed whether that spot is required, but doing it early costs nothing and removes the risk. A meditation only counts once its final 'zen' animation has played, so stay until the animation finishes. Track progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and find spots at Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting strand and hunt the unique animal he asks for. Follow Bret's missions as they appear: he marks the hunting ground, and the target animal is the one his strand is built around — not a random animal. Bring a scoped rifle, approach downwind and take the shot from cover; a clean single shot is the point of the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets — finish every card in three sets. Pick the sets whose cards cluster in one area and clear those first instead of chasing single cards across the map. Track progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. Cards you sell at Pawn Shops still count toward your sets, so selling duplicates is safe. For 100% completion you will need 15 sets, so this trophy comes naturally on the way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on Jason's or Lucia's phone (hold Up to open it). The scannable things are landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags — scan anything the app highlights as you pass it, and the total climbs fast in Vice City itself. Track progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges — the game's in-game feats for skilful play, listed at Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges. You do not need to pick hard ones: open the list, take the easy ones first (driving, shooting and exploration feats), and let the rest accumulate while you do the other trophies. Note that 70 Challenges are needed for 100% completion, so keep the list open during the final clean-up.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose it and escape the red heat zone on the map. Bank vault robberies often raise the wanted level to 4 stars on their own, which pairs this trophy with Maximum Withdrawal. Once the stars are flashing, break line of sight and get out of the red zone — a train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a reported hiding spot. The trophy pops once the heat is fully gone, not when the stars first start dropping.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without the Wanted Level clearing between them — you must stay wanted the whole time, so move fast from one shop to the next. The jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together, which makes the run short. Do not leave the red heat zone and do not let the stars fade; if the trophy does not pop after the third shop, rob a fourth while still wanted.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or by scanning it, so this climbs on its own as you play — drive something new whenever you see it instead of sticking to one car. Track what you have found at Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles. Car parks, docks and the airport are good places to find models you have not driven yet.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. While aiming a firearm, press L3 and R3 together to switch it on, and Adrenaline stretches how long it lasts. Use an assault rifle and pick a clustered group of gang enemies — gang members count, while cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to. Fill your Focus meter first, then start the fight; five quick takedowns inside one activation pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger jet at Vice City International Airport. Take a large plane that is connected to a boarding bridge — the ones at terminals E3 and E4 work — go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse toward the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport; the unlock is delayed, so keep flying until it pops instead of landing straight away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle: Rhinos are the game's tanks. Early guides had not confirmed the exact trigger at launch, so treat this as the one trophy to check again once more players report it. The working reading is to take on Rhino tanks — draw the heaviest military response you can, engage the tanks rather than running from them, and survive the encounter. If it does not pop, keep the save from before the attempt and try a different tank encounter.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarm, no witness spotting you. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun; it makes a quiet robbery far easier. Case the store, wait until the staff's backs are turned, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try another store rather than fighting it out.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission, so take that mission when it appears. Every vault robbery brings a 4-star Wanted Level, so park a fast bike nearby before you go in and have your escape route planned. This pairs well with Hot Together, since the same 4-star escape counts there.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, take the cash and get away. Like the other robbery trophies, you also need to escape the red heat zone afterwards, so plan the getaway before you strike: a fast car parked nearby and a route out of the area.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — all 52 named areas on the in-game map. Driving through an area counts, so the simplest method is to work across the map region by region after the story, checking each area name as it appears on screen. Mop up the stragglers with a helicopter or fast car: the small islands and the far corners of the map are the ones players usually leave last.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Illegal Operations appear as marked gang businesses on the map — hit one per gang, not nine in total from the same gang. Keep a list of which gangs you have done, since the game does not always make it obvious which gang owns a given spot; the last one is usually the gang whose territory you have visited least.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar along Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take it to a spot overlooking the water. Early guides had not confirmed the exact bar or seat at launch, so if it does not pop at the first bar, try another beachfront spot — the trigger is the cocktail plus the view, not a specific mission. A quiet evening visit, with no wanted level, is the easiest attempt.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out onto the street. Early guides had not confirmed the exact showroom at launch, so pick a large dealership with a glass front, get a fast car inside or lined up outside, and drive through. The 'classic style' hint points to a full-speed exit, not a gentle nudge.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the alley, start a game and follow through — play the frames properly rather than walking away mid-game. Any completed game at this alley counts, so it pairs naturally with the Master of None activity trophy. The alley is the one the description names, so other bowling spots do not count for this one.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A story trophy with a deliberately vague description. It pops during the campaign, at a partnership moment, so there is no separate task to hunt and no grind — keep playing the story and it comes to you. Early guides list it among the trophies that unlock through the campaign rather than through a specific action.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that affect your Criminal Profile. The counter behind it is the game's record of what you do: robberies, enemy encounters and other criminal actions all add up. Leave this one until the other jobs are done — it builds naturally through normal play, and a separate grind is usually unnecessary. Check your Criminal Profile in the Progress menu to see how the total is growing.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A story trophy with a riddle for a description — 'second time's the charm'. Early guides list its exact method as unconfirmed, and the clue points to succeeding at something on the second attempt. It is grouped with the trophies that unlock through the campaign, so play the story through and it should pop at its moment; do not go hunting for a separate task until more players confirm one.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A story trophy with a riddle for a description — 'what the hell just happened?' Early guides list its exact method as unconfirmed, and the clue points to witnessing something strange during the campaign. Play the story through; it is grouped with the trophies that pop at story moments rather than through a hunted task, so keep an eye out for odd scripted events as you play.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl targets over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock people down. The precise method was still being confirmed in early guides, so the working method is: drive slowly past a group on foot, swing the melee weapon from the vehicle, and knock down as many as you can in the pass. Pick a quiet street with pedestrians, not a mission area, so a failed attempt costs nothing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your laundering contacts instead of spending them directly, and the total adds up across the whole game. You do not need $250,000 at once — it is a running total, so keep laundering after every big job and it pops during normal crime play.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — a running total, not one purchase. Find shops on the map at Touch Pad, Style, and spend however you like: clothes, food, vehicle upgrades and weapons all count. It is one of the easiest trophies in the set and usually pops on its own while you gear up for the harder ones.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties, for $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone (press Up to open the phone). The eight are: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; and Store n' Bolt $16,800. Each garage adds one vehicle storage slot, and the slots are what the Scooter Bros trophy needs.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which delivers your repaired vehicles to your location for a small fee. Register a vehicle you are driving at any Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop, as long as you have an empty parking spot — the fee varies with the vehicle's value. Buy more garages from the Vice City Real Estate app if you run out of spots, and register ten different vehicles to pop the trophy.
